known_discrepancies.detail: EICV7 Main Indicators Report narrative (§9) quotes 46.6%; the report's own district figure, Poverty Profile Annex B and Excel Table A9.23 all give 45.6%. We use 45.6%.

known_discrepancies.item: Annex B vs Table A9.23 (2024 poverty)
known_discrepancies.detail: Poverty Profile Annex B prints Burera 22.0 (Excel 21.8), Nyabihu 20.2 (Excel 20.4), Nyamasheke 42.8 (Excel 42.7) and Rwamagana 23.8 (Excel 23.9). We use the Excel values for 2024 and Annex B only for the 2017 modelled values and the printed decrease.
EICV5 (2017) district rates in Annex B are NISR model predictions on the EICV7 consumption basis, not EICV5 published rates; province CIs (Table 5.1) are model-dependent.
